root_cause.text: The mb_cache_destroy() function fails to cancel the pending c_shrink_work work item before freeing the cache's memory and calling shrinker_free(), allowing a concurrent or pending workqueue worker to access freed cache data, resulting in a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cancel_work_sync(&cache->c_shrink_work);` before `shrinker_free(cache->c_shrink);` in mb_cache_destroy(). The CVE description states: "mb_cache_destroy() calls shrinker_free() and then frees all cache entries and the cache itself, but it does not cancel the pending c_shrink_work work item first. If ... and the work item is still pending or running when mb_cache_destroy() runs, mb_cache_shrink_worker() will access the cache after its memory has been freed, causing a use-after-free."

intent_record.intent_summary: Before freeing the shrinker, cancel any pending shrink work to prevent use-after-free during cache destruction.
intent_record.what: Added call to cancel_work_sync(&cache->c_shrink_work) before freeing the shrinker in mb_cache_destroy.
intent_record.how: Ensures that any pending or running shrink work is completed before the shrinker is freed, preventing a race condition where the work could access freed memory.
